description: This file contains utility mixins and functions for evaluating variables, maps, mixins, and color manipulations, primarily used in Bootstrap's styling framework. It includes validation functions, string manipulation, and color contrast utilities.

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixin to validate that a Sass map is in ascending order based on its numeric values.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to ensure that the first breakpoint in a map starts at 0.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Function to replace all occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: color-yiq
methods.description: Function to determine contrasting text color based on background color using the YIQ algorithm.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a color from the $colors map by key.

methods.name: theme-color
methods.description: Function to retrieve a theme color from the $theme-colors map by key.

methods.name: gray
methods.description: Function to retrieve a gray shade from the $grays map by key.

methods.name: theme-color-level
methods.description: Function to compute a shade of a theme color based on level parameter.
